boundary: Financial / Assets would be right as a second label if the export included full card numbers or security codes (or otherwise enabled direct payment); since those fields are explicitly excluded, only the confidentiality breach is direct.
factor: partial payment metadata (last four digits, billing details) versus usable payment credentials
note: The assessor claimed the payment references and billing data can be misused directly, an unsupported claim given the excluded full card number and security code; that misreading added the Financial label.
